budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Deliver each vessel's parcel to its private berth on the opposite bank. Own completion pays 0.75 plus a public 0.25 per completion to every role, creating both urgency and shared benefit.
task.natural_termination: All three vessels are resolved (delivered or fuel-stranded), or the 80-step horizon truncates. Service lasts two later transitions. A natural resolution at H has priority.
task.interaction: Public directional requests allocate short exclusive entrance leases before simultaneous movement. Traffic can block, reserve, yield or strand others. The lower crossing closes for half of each eight-step tide cycle; one-vessel berths retain service occupancy for two steps.
task.observation_access: All vessel positions, fuel, lantern signals, cargo status, passage reservations, tide, berth occupancy and event flags are public radar data. Only own destination id/position is returned; destination entities have identity visibility. Other private destinations are never displayed in role views. Waiting/servicing/finished/stranded roles retain no-op; only active fueled vessels can issue other commands.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Passage reservations granted or renewed this transition
Vessel maneuver intents denied by tide/reservation/terrain/traffic
Vessel movement intents blocked by another vessel or a shared target
Vessels entering a passage cell this transition
Vessels beginning berth service this transition
Vessels finishing service and departing this transition
Vessels newly exhausting fuel outside service this transition
Vessels newly caught on the closing tidal passage this transition

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
